name: Mahirap na pamilya
text: Mahirap na pamilya. Close ang samahan, pero tight ang pera.
text_en: Low-income family. Close bonds, tight money.

name: Pamilya ng vendor/driver
text: Pamilya ng vendor/driver. Marunong makibagay, walang koneksyon.

name: Pamilyang OFW
text: Pamilyang OFW. May padala, pero malayo ang pamilya.
text_en: OFW family. Remittances come, but family is far.

name: Pamilya ng kawani
bonus_note: More favors offered early (higher Utang risk).
penalty_note: More favors offered early (higher Utang risk).
text: Pamilya ng kawani. Maraming kakilala, madaming alok na pabor.
text_en: Government employee family. Many acquaintances, many favors offered.

name: Pamilyang may negosyo
text: Pamilyang may negosyo. Komportable, pero abala.

name: Pamilyang guro/propesyonal
text: Pamilyang guro/propesyonal. Masinop sa aralin, tight ang pera.
text_en: Teacher/professional family. Strong in study, tight money.
